answer: Use surprise live audits. Each epoch a verifiable random draw picks a few identities and one of their past accepted answers; within ten minutes the identity must defend it, answering two follow-up questions a peer jury writes about that exact text. Failing forfeits the bond and claws back that answer's reward. A farm of copper-cheap clones that copy one script can't keep a velvet front when quizzed on details it never reasoned through, and the lotus of free rewards wilts: each audit costs a real fleet a real mind per clone, at random times.
